distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Ledger Rule + Status Stamp signature in 4 sections (hero entries, 'What we fix' rows, 'From the ledger' reviews, footer total row). IBM Plex Mono display + iron/steel-blue/copper palette avoids the banned water-drop-blue plumber cliché. Held below 9: placeholder photos mean identity is carried by type/rule alone, and section shapes (split/stack/ruled-grid) are fairly conventional. No sibling plumber sites to collide with.

type.notes: 1440-full.jpg pricing table + ledger rows: IBM Plex Mono display/numerals + Outfit body; fluid clamp scale; tabular-nums on prices/phone/hours/entry numbers; lead set apart; tracked-caps kickers; balance/pretty wrap. Mono-as-display carries the field-ledger concept — ID-able from text alone. Body >=16px, no orphans or straight-quote ranges spotted.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg / 390-full.jpg: composed-for-phone layout, h1 ~3 lines, both actions above fold, sticky Call + Price-it bar, ledger entries stack, full-width form fields, no horizontal scroll, tap targets >=48px (min-height:48px). 1024-first.jpg holds the split without breaking.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: skip-link styled; :focus-visible outline; every input has a real <label for>; reduced-motion safety net forces transitions ~0 and .sw-motion gating keeps content in DOM/visible; forced-colors borders on controls; honeypot aria-hidden + tabindex -1; single h1 with h2 per section; lang=en; noindex. render.json zero console errors.

motion.notes: dist/index.html + kit CSS vs stills: beyond plain fade-up — clip-path wipe on ledger rule via --sw-p, count-up numerals, SplitText reveals, rotator slot, Lenis, staggered reveals, press-scale. Reduced-motion fully respected. Capped below 9: static stills cannot confirm easing/timing, intro <1.2s, or that the foot-counter story reverses — hooks present and gated, execution unverified visually.

wow.notes: 1440-full.jpg: page-as-ledger + diagnostic tools (pipe-material ID, pressure check, sewer-era check) tied to thesis and genuinely useful pre-call. Steel-blue 'Take your own readings first' band is the signature moment. Held below 9: the tool band reads as a flat empty accent block in the still — interactive output designed in the ledger language not yet visually confirmed.

polish.notes: dist/index.html head: SVG favicon + 180 apple-touch-icon, OG 1200x630 + twitter card, JSON-LD @type Plumber with areaServed + openingHours, theme-color, print stylesheet scoped to estimator, lazy images with explicit width/height, forced-colors handling, preloaded display font. Consistent zero-radius, one 1.5px rule weight, one accent. Footer is a designed ledger close (total row + final rule).

elevate.move: Art-direct the frames as a plan->work->result sequence in one grade: hero = sewer-camera still of a clay joint with root (logged by the foot), story = gauge-on-hosebib + galvanized/lead pipes under a work light, area = Pittsburgh brick row house at dusk. Apply the existing saturate(.8)/contrast(1.1)/sepia(.05) grade uniformly, set object-position to a third, and tie one frame to the signature with a clip-reveal driven by the same --sw-p wipe as the ledger rule so a photo and the rule draw in together.

Re-tone the lower half so the scroll reads loud->quiet->dense->breath: deep hero -> paper services -> deep tools -> paper estimator -> deep reviews -> PAPER pricing -> deep area -> paper form -> deep footer. Let the ledger rule run continuously across the tonal breaks so the rule, not the background, is the through-line and the dark bands stop merging.
